name: Rendering Equation Encoding (REE)
aliases: encode the rendering equation in the feature space
definition: A technique to model view-dependent effects by encoding the rendering equation in the feature space using predicted anisotropic spherical Gaussian mixture parameters, instead of directly encoding view directions.
summary: Rendering Equation Encoding models view-dependent effects by encoding the rendering equation into feature space using Anisotropic Spherical Gaussian parameters, allowing the network to learn complex specular reflections through underlying physics rather than standard view direction encoding.
